entry_indicator: No clean momentum trigger was present at the actual entry 2.8 at 04:28:16, as pre-market liquidity was thin and lacked a defined breakout level.
exit_indicator: No clear technical exit trigger was present at 2.93 at 09:19:36; the exit appeared to be a random time-based decision rather than a response to a tape signal.
verdict: The trade was entered at 04:28:16 at a price of 2.8 and held until 09:19:36, spanning nearly five hours without a defined momentum day-trading catalyst or clear intraday structure. Day trading momentum playbooks require rapid execution within high-volume morning hours, whereas this position lingered through the pre-market into the regular session. Furthermore, holding a momentum trade for nearly five hours violates strict risk management rules and exposes the account to unpredictable reversals.

better_entry.reason: Entering at 2.75 at the 09:30:00 market open captures the opening bell liquidity and volatility rather than taking an arbitrary pre-market fill at 2.8.
better_entry.how_to_know: Price opens at 09:30:00 with a surge in volume breaking above the morning consolidation high of 2.75.

better_exit.reason: Exiting at 2.95 at 09:35:00 secures a clean initial morning push rather than holding a stagnant position until 09:19:36.
better_exit.how_to_know: Price reaches the 2.95 resistance level and stalls on the 5-minute candle at 09:35:00.

walk_away_rule: Walk away from any trade that fails to show momentum within 15 minutes of the 09:30:00 market open rather than holding deep into the session.

lessons.lesson: Avoid holding momentum day trades for hours; the 5-hour duration from 04:28:16 to 09:19:36 contradicts fast day-trading execution.
lessons.how_to_know: Check the elapsed time on the trade log; if the position has been open past 15 minutes without hitting target or stop, exit.

lessons.lesson: Do not enter illiquid pre-market hours at 2.8 without confirmed volume and a clear catalyst.
lessons.how_to_know: Verify that pre-market volume exceeds average relative volume and prints a clean reclaim of the morning high.
